source.identityVerification: Captured from the final verified working tree. The source commit object was created after capture; the staged tree was compared with the remote source tree and matched exactly. The rendered component inputs were unchanged between the final build, capture, and commit.

build.artifactTreeHashDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines <file sha256><two spaces><relative POSIX path><newline>, sorted by relative path across every file in storybook-static.
build.scope: Built Storybook component captures using synthetic observations, reference distributions, and predictions. Package checks are separate nonvisual evidence; these images do not assert downstream application adoption.

capture.presentationChanges: None. Actual built components, without injected CSS or generated imagery. Screenshot helper dismisses transient hover/focus popovers. The focused comparison crop is the actual map panel.

verifiedBehavior: Canonical explicit event topology including forks, rejoins, revisits, independent origins and an unassigned delivery
Map, graph, markers and path swatches agree on candidate colors in light and dark themes; shared locations stay neutral
Inline and inspector histograms use the supplied candidate predecessor and exact reference bins
Two simultaneous prediction overlays have independent keyboard-operable switches and never create event rows
Prediction controls and geometry are scoped to the focused candidate; choices survive leaving and returning
Selection, view switching, prediction changes and keyboard interactions preserve camera and selected-event state
Narrow and short-screen layouts keep the selected record and inspector accessible
Forced-colors equivalents preserve shared and selected graph-node distinctions
validation.independentReview: No remaining actionable findings; final marker membership derivation separately rechecked.

packageVerification.note: Existing React useLayoutEffect SSR warnings are present and non-failing.

limits: Browser capture and automation used Chromium; automated accessibility checks do not establish full conformance.
All example measurements and predictions are synthetic; no inferred shipment truth or forecast model is provided.
